result.explanation: Maintain FIFO residents with stored values, pin counts, and tombstone flags. Puts replace only live residents; new puts evict the oldest unpinned resident when necessary. Invalidated pinned residents remain until their final unpin.
result.mapping: The opaque state is an array of resident records {key,value,pins,tomb}; array order is FIFO. Outputs are derived from that array after each event.
result.assumptions: Statuses are stored, pinned, released, invalidated, hit, miss, blocked, missing, or ignored according to the operation result. Eviction itself does not change the successful put status.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const o of output){if(!o||!Array.isArray(o.order)||!o.pins||!Array.isArray(o.tombstones)||typeof o.status!=="string"||!(o.value===null||Number.isSafeInteger(o.value)))return false;for(const k of o.order)if(typeof k!=="string"||k.endsWith("__changed"))return false;for(const k of o.tombstones)if(!o.order.includes(k)||o.pins[k]<=0)return false}return true}
